title: Final Judgment
definition: Final judgment is the future act of God by which He will judge all people with perfect justice through Jesus Christ.
summary: God will judge all people righteously, vindicating His justice and revealing the truth.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the appointed Judge, and those who are in Him are saved from condemnation.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Final judgment teaches that history is moving toward God's public and righteous evaluation of all people. Nothing is hidden from Him. Every evil will be exposed, every injustice answered, and every person held accountable.

God's judgment is not cruel or arbitrary. It is holy, true, and righteous. The Judge of all the earth will do what is right.

For believers, final judgment is faced in Christ. There is no condemnation for those who are in Him. Their works will be assessed, but their salvation rests in the Savior who bore judgment for them.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people fear that evil will never be answered or assume accountability can be avoided. Final judgment matters because it assures justice, warns sinners, and magnifies the mercy found in Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live with holy seriousness and Gospel confidence. Confess sin, seek justice, forgive personal vengeance to God, and proclaim Christ as the Savior from coming judgment.
